newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-BERGER HAS FURTHER SURGERY ON SINUS INFECTION.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BERGER HAS FURTHER SURGERY ON SINUS INFECTION.

text.p: Austrian Gerhard Berger has undergone further surgery on the sinus infection which forced him to miss last weekend's Canadian Grand Prix in Montreal.
The veteran Benetton driver originally had surgery on the problem three weeks ago, and was in some pain on Wednesday.
The next three days will be decisive, although no decision will be made on his participation in the French Grand Prix on June 29 until next week, said a spokesman for the driver.
Benetton managing director Flavio Briatore said: "It is possible he can recover quickly -- hopefully enough to be back at Magny-Cours."
